text: Sorry if this is me overreacting, I honestly can't tell anymore. My son Ollie is 18 months and he's been under the weather since yesterday. His temp is 38 on the ear thermometer. He's had a few insect bites on his legs from the garden, which he keeps scratching, but that's not really why I'm messaging. He's just not himself at all. He's been lying on the sofa like a ragdoll most of the evening, and when I picked him up he just flopped against me. Normally he'd be wriggling to get down. I tried to rouse him properly about half an hour ago and it took ages to get him to open his eyes, and even then he didn't really look at me the way he usually does, just sort of drifted off again. He hasn't had anything since lunchtime either. I've offered milk, water, juice, even his favourite yoghurt, and he turns his head away from all of it, won't take a single sip. I checked his skin all over because my sister told me to, and there's no rash anywhere, only the bites, and I did the glass thing on those and they go pale. My partner says he's probably just worn out from being poorly and I should let him sleep, and maybe he's right, I don't want to waste anyone's time. It just doesn't feel like him.
